{
  "description": "Ask before Claude runs a Mintlify admin MCP tool that publishes, merges, deletes or has site-wide effect: publish (which can also merge the pull request), discard, delete_node, move_node (renames page paths), update_config (theme, redirects, SEO, integrations), approving or publishing review requests, and every project-management write (deployment settings, custom domain, Git source, authentication, automations and their pull requests, members). Page edits, comments and reads still run freely: they stay unpublished until publish, except in projects with auto publish and in bases, where Mintlify commits them to the deploy branch at once (add ask rules for edit_page and write_page there). Ask rules win over allow rules, so this holds even if mcp__mintlify-admin is allowed. Only covers a server named 'mintlify-admin' (as installed by --mcp devtools/mintlify-admin).",
  "permissions": {
    "ask": [
      "mcp__mintlify-admin__publish",
      "mcp__mintlify-admin__discard",
      "mcp__mintlify-admin__delete_node",
      "mcp__mintlify-admin__update_config",
      "mcp__mintlify-admin__move_node",
      "mcp__mintlify-admin__approve_review_request",
      "mcp__mintlify-admin__publish_review_request",
      "mcp__mintlify-admin__update_deployment_settings",
      "mcp__mintlify-admin__manage_custom_domain",
      "mcp__mintlify-admin__manage_git_source",
      "mcp__mintlify-admin__manage_access_auth",
      "mcp__mintlify-admin__manage_workflow",
      "mcp__mintlify-admin__manage_workflow_prs",
      "mcp__mintlify-admin__manage_members_sharing"
    ]
  }
}
